categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Changes C API implementation in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp, headers in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h, and kernel tests in src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a critical boundary correctness bug where validating a block under one set of parameters mutates internal flags (`fChecked`) and causes subsequent checks under different parameters to falsely pass. The description notes that on master, a regtest block checked once allows `btck_block_check` with mainnet params to return 1, and connecting across different signet challenges causes chains to fail reading back their own tips.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Excluded by the validation category definition, which specifies that PRs whose primary subject is the kernel library API belong in kernel rather than validation.
categories.rationale: Although labeled Validation, the PR exclusively modifies the `libbitcoinkernel` C API wrapper and kernel tests without altering core validation logic or invariants in `src/validation`.
